# 0038: Governed prose and HITLMAN anchor the uplift

Status: accepted
Type: strategy
Date: 2026-10-23

Request: "remember the prose as code concepts and the hitmlman are especially
critical to get amazingly well. and to work witht he app-kit to ensure they ahve
excelllent uis as well." (owner, 2026-10-23).

## Context

The owner emphasizes G12/G13 after 0037's inventory/evidence/review planning.
0027/0028 bind immutable input-derived prose and exact human/agent transactions;
0029 chooses one workbench family with independent task semantics. Those decisions
stand. The new IR plan inadvertently delayed IR-11's UI work behind IR-10's
two-consumer adapter proof, although experimental one-consumer UI is allowed.

## Decision

Make governed prose and HITLMAN the program's anchor experiences. Accept the
[priority and PX acceptance](../../designs/agentic-engineering/prose-hitl-priority.md)
as a refinement of PH/HW/WB and 0037, not a replacement or runtime implementation.
Use a source-correction dossier as the first candidate evidence reference so shared
utilities serve the human/prose task. Keep the app/database case as a secondary fixture.

Admitted W3 work follows existing AE-4/authority prerequisites, not all W2 work or
IR-10. Qualifying native Review Kit ingress remains necessary before claiming that
interop; it does not prohibit separately admitted proof using existing HITL/prose
contracts. Experimental app-kit specimens do not require two consumers; permanent
shared UI APIs keep their layer-specific promotion gates.

Protect the end-to-end task: select exact node/version, inspect support/criteria,
resolve facts or annotate presentation, preview dependency/context closure, rebuild
immutable variants, compare intended change, authorize exact effects, publish or hold,
and reconcile unknown delivery. Required semantic and human-task evidence are separate.

Use app-kit's contribution loop for reusable interaction, state and accessibility
work. Retain domain authority and app-owned identity/storage/effects. Existing metadata,
prototype layouts and private editor specimens do not prove a production workbench.
Record exact discovery/gaps and prepared packets in docs/app-kit.md; no automatic
consumer or global mutation is implied. This decision changes no runtime/API or gate,
opens no incubation and does not mark G12/G13 or AE-8..11 complete.

## Alternatives rejected

- Finish a universal inventory/evidence platform before the anchor experience.
  Wins if: a named prerequisite demonstrably blocks the selected human/prose task.
- Require two adopted apps before any human UI pilot.
  Wins if: promoting a permanent shared component; not for a bounded specimen.
- Treat an approval card or editor demo as a complete HITLMAN/prose solution.
  Wins if: never without the actual task, domain wiring and acceptance evidence.

## Revisit when

Anchor tasks miss correctness, attention, accessibility or recovery bars; shared
work displaces them without a demonstrated prerequisite; app-kit cannot preserve
domain law; two consumers prove a missing common interaction; or 2026-11-21/next
release arrives. Keep no-evidence implementation queued rather than claiming excellence.
